entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Yeah, yeah, just get me someone. I need to make a return.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I...
I need to return my cycling shoes. Order number is VF88675. Can I do it, yes or no?
Okay, one moment while I pull that up, VF88675. I see the order here. Just so I can document it correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes?
Look, they don't fit. They gave me horrible blisters right on my heel. The pressure point near the cleats is all wrong. I just want my money back. Can you process the refund or not?
I'm very sorry to hear about the blisters. I've just checked your purchase date, and you are well within our 90-day return policy for standard items. So yes, I can absolutely process that for you.

I have just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file now. You should see it in the next 5 minutes. Once we receive the cycling shoes back at our warehouse, your refund will be issued to your original payment method.
Fine. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
